x.visible_pattern: Evenly spaced wavelength ticks from 300 to 800 in 100 nm increments.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear model; best linear normalized RMSE was about 0.00024, much lower than log10.

y.visible_pattern: Evenly spaced absorbance ticks from 0.0 to 0.8 in 0.2 increments.
y.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear model; best linear normalized RMSE was about 0.00037, and log10 is incompatible with the visible zero tick.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: The blue low-intensity tail becomes visually ambiguous against the black baseline tail after roughly x≈725 px, so a separate recovery pass could revisit that hidden continuation if needed.

curves.overlap_notes: Trace remains distinct except for close blue-tail crowding near the far-right baseline.
Visible dashed segments are clear through the descending flank and early tail, but the far-right low-intensity tail crowds the black trace near the baseline and was truncated conservatively.
curves.suspected_gap_notes: Likely continuation persists beyond x≈725 px, but it is not cleanly separable from the black tail.

curves.overlap_notes: Dash-dot trace is distinct; only the far-right tail approaches neighboring low-intensity tails.
Dotted trace stays visually dominant and separable across the full sweep.

response.interpretation_notes: Extracted four concentration-series UV-Vis curves from the main plot only. Legend glyphs in the upper-right were excluded. The blue tail was truncated where it became ambiguous against the black baseline tail; the green dotted curve remains complete but still carries a QA warn because dotted-point interpolation under-hits some gap pixels.
unresolved_ambiguities: The blue C=10 μM tail beyond about x=725 px is present but too close to the black tail to keep as a reliable full-extent extraction.
The green C=30 μM dotted trace is visually separable, but overlap QA still reports a warn-level hit rate on the dotted interpolation.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
